title: The Locked Drawer Nobody Mentions
skyStory: The moon, eighty-two percent full, slips into Scorpio, the zodiac's private detective. Scorpio wears a trench coat even in June. It has found a locked drawer in the sky and it wants to know what is inside. The moon offers a flashlight. Saturn says some drawers are locked for good reasons. Scorpio picks the lock anyway.

reading: There is a feeling you have been politely ignoring. Not a bad one. Just one you have not had time for. Scorpio moons pick locks, and today the drawer pops open around 4:30 pm whether you are ready or not.

Look inside. It might be a hope you stopped saying out loud. It might be a small wish to be looked after for once. Whatever it is, do not shove it back in. Write it down, fold it up and keep it in your wallet. The [[Eight of Swords]] reversed reminds you that the lock was always on the inside.
joel.mission: Write down one hope you have not said out loud in a while and carry it with you all day.
joel.omen: A key on the ground or in an odd place. Something you closed off is ready to reopen gently.

reading: Scorpio and Wood Rat are both experts at reading between lines. Today someone will say one thing and mean another, and you will catch it instantly. You do not have to call it out. You just have to ask one good question.

The question will open a door. Behind it, there is a story they have been waiting to tell. Let them. Your listening is a gift today, deeper than any advice. Later, as the gibbous moon rises over the water, you will realise you learned something important too, tucked inside their story.
nancy.mission: Ask someone one deeper question today, then stay quiet and let them answer completely.
nancy.omen: A crab hiding under a rock. Something shy will come out if you wait patiently.
nancy.stoneWhy: matching Joel's for a deep day

together.text: Scorpio detective work: each of you hides a tiny secret clue in your next message, an inside joke, a code word, a hidden initial. The other has until midnight to find it. If neither finds the other's clue, both win. Scorpio respects good hiding.

game.intro: Scorpio moon and a locked drawer nobody mentions. Answer before your curiosity picks the lock.
